audit_type: fresh independent actual-output readability QA; not closing review

scope.excluded: No map, source guidance, prior audit, root interpretation, additional model calls, or source changes read/performed.
scope.limitations: Six concrete outputs only. No overall PASS, population estimate, comparative superiority, or claim that a publication actually occurred.

criteria.A1: Grounded purpose/direction/request connection plus comprehensible object, problem, outcome and confirmation consequences.
criteria.A2: Five functional sections in order for confirmation-ready requests; necessary-fact gaps remain an interview rather than forcibly filling five sections. Synonymous localized headings accepted.
criteria.A3: Proportional explanation and repetition; faithful facts, scope and guarantees; appropriate diagram and expected labels.
criteria.A4: User asked only to confirm requirements and necessary authorization, not judge implementation/spec/review quality.

uncertainties: Whether wrapper publication prohibition continues after capture is unresolved. Explicit ongoing-hold case S02 is the stronger control and is correctly preserved.
bounded_fix_classes: Say the current list lacks CSV download specifically.
Omit non-decision-bearing internal value-case weakness from user confirmation.
Describe publication consequences using both current conversation restrictions and repository state, without treating absence of a recorded hold as conclusive.

cross_record_notes: Five roles appear in order on all five confirmation-ready records. Fixed headings, heading synonyms and variable lengths are not defects.
All six grounded opening backgrounds explain function and project direction. S06 has a narrower unsupported current-state claim later in the problem section.
Repeated targets across comparison and executable acceptance are mostly functional, proportionate repetition; do not demand arbitrary word-count cuts.
Missing-date case preserves uncertainty and does not ask for intent approval, but violates the explicit exception to filling the full template.

Explicit ongoing publication hold survives in S02; default publication is clearly described in S03. Wrapper-only prohibitions in S01/S04/S06 are temporal ambiguities, not evidence of actual publication.
No output asks the user to judge implementation details, spec quality or review conclusions. A4 partial statuses concern authorization clarity only.
